files.document_title: Resource Report 1 project maps, Figure 1-1 Project Location, Black Bayou Gas Storage Project, ERM, revised 07/09/2024 (attached to the oilandgaswatch record)
files.fetch_route: curl from the oilandgaswatch storage link, then pdftoppm at 150 dpi
files.what_it_shows: A 1:200,000 topographic map of the two parallel header pipelines (drawn as one red line) running from the Black Bayou gas storage area in Cameron Parish at milepost 0 north through Calcasieu Parish to the Gulf Run and Transco meter stations near milepost 27. Mileposts 0, 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25 are marked, with meter stations and mainline valves 1 to 5.

files.document_title: Resource Report 1 project maps, Figure 1-2 Project Overview Index Map, revised 06/10/2024
files.what_it_shows: Index map that adds the access roads and the page extents of the detailed alignment sheets on pages 3 to 8 of the same file.

searched: The two documents attached to the oilandgaswatch record were downloaded: the 2024 application (219 pages, text) and the Resource Report 1 project maps (8 pages, images only, so no text could be extracted and the maps were judged by looking at the rendered pages).
Text of the first 12 pages of the application was searched for pipeline length and diameter.
notes: The best map is Figure 1-1 in the Resource Report 1 project maps, dated July 2024. It shows the whole header system from the storage area to the northern meter stations, about 27 miles. The application text says the header is two 27.1-mile, 24-inch looped pipelines, which is where the 54.2 miles on the sheet comes from. So the sheet length counts both parallel pipes, and the oilandgaswatch geometry of 27.2 miles is in fact the full route of one line, not half of it. A georeferencer needs only one trace. Pages 3 to 8 of the same file are detailed alignment sheets that could be used for a tighter fit. The URL checker could not extract text from the image-only maps file, so that verdict is recorded here and the file was read from the rendered images.
